THE ART ROOM · SCHOOL ROOM · AGES 2–5

Paintbrush

The upgrade that turns coloring into painting. Big sweeps cover the whole page — background first, sky before birds — the same studio order real painters keep.

The card’s activity

“Paint a bright background” — printed on the card.

Make it now

Set the supply out and run the card’s activity twice — once slowly, once with full artist confidence. The card is the assignment; the rest of this page is bonus.

Keep going

The Paintbrush has its own full lesson — what the tool is, what the activity trains, the parent script and the questions to ask — plus a printable card page in the library. Make the thing; the rest follows the favorite.
